items.t: ‘Carl Icahn Did Not Play Nice:’ Michael Dell Takes a Swipe at Billionaire as Activist Investor’s Fortune Reportedly Shrinks by $21 Billion
items.sum: Michael Dell revived his 2013 feud with Carl Icahn, saying Icahn “did not play nice and did not win” as his fortune and firm face pressure.

items.t: Carl Icahn Bets 86% of His Portfolio on Two Stocks After $21B Wealth Wipeout
items.sum: Carl Icahn's 13F shows 86% of his $9.4B portfolio sits in IEP and CVR, which both fell more than 45% as debt pressure builds.

items.t: Icahn Enterprises (IEP) Stock Is Down 7.5% Today Amid Broad Market Selloff
items.sum: Icahn Enterprises shares fell 7.5% on Wednesday, Nov. 25, without company-specific news, as a broad AI-led selloff hit the market.

items.t: Icahn's Fortune Sinks to $1.3b as Debt Pressures Rise
items.sum: Carl Icahn's fortune has dwindled to about $1.3 billion as mounting debt squeezes his business empire, leaving the longtime corporate raider and activist investor facing one of the toughest stretches of his career. items.t: Icahn Enterprises (IEP) Stock Is Down 6.4% Today Without Company News
items.sum: On Tuesday, Nov. 24, the stock fell 6.4% without company-specific news, as the S&P 500 dropped 1.2%.

items.t: Billionaire Carl Icahn Has 86% of His $9.4 Billion Stock Portfolio in Just Two Companies
items.sum: Carl Icahn's latest filing reads less like a stock portfolio and more like a map of his own empire. Retirement investors tempted to copy it should first ask who really controls the risk, and who pays when the payouts shrink.
